concepts.name: Still Companion
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a final-quality square symbol-only software logo concept for a Culture-inspired terminal workbench where peer agents cooperate toward human goals.
Style: exceptionally simple, distinctive, cute but cool, professional modern identity design; crisp bold vector-like raster shapes with balanced negative space. It must remain identifiable at 32 by 32 pixels. One icon only, centered and filling about 68% of the square, with generous clear margin for circular avatar crops.
Background: completely solid opaque deep navy #08121f extending to all four edges. Palette: warm white #f3f3e8, cyan #59e4ed, lilac #afa6f3; use only the colors needed by this concept. Solid clean colors, no grain, no speckling, no texture.
Constraints: SYMBOL ONLY. No letters, no wordmarks, no R monogram, no text, no captions, no watermark, no border, no UI mockup, no photography. No insect or dragonfly wings, antennae, limbs, humanoid robot faces, or complex circuitry. The white drone is a symbolic homage, not an official Culture logo. Flat icon, not a glossy app button. 1024 by 1024 square output.
Concept: A friendly autonomous white drone seen as a thick gently tilted oval disc. The white disc has ONE bold curved dark inset groove suggesting independently moving outer casing, with an unmarked solid core. A short cyan crescent hugs its lower edge, and one small lilac square hovers separately above-right as a quiet signal. Compact sculptural silhouette, restrained three-shape design, NO face. The disc dominates and the signal is secondary; no thin concentric rings.
